title: 'No Scripts, Just Football' - GOALS Arrives For Free On Xbox This Week
summary:
A game where skill is said to decide everything.

The modern-day football / soccer game scene, at least in the AAA space, feels a little underbaked. EA Sports FC 26 is decent but predictable, eFootball 2026 isn't as good as PES used to be (sorry, personal bias there!), and UFL is a fun Ultimate Team alternative, but it's the only other major option if you don't want to play EA or Konami's games.

Could GOALS spruce things up a little bit? Well, it depends on what you're looking for out of a football game. You're not getting single-player career modes here — this is once again an online-focused title that utilises the Ultimate Team formula — but the interesting part is that player skill is the main focus above all else in the game.

The first Stuntman game since Ignition in 2007.

title: Xbox Teases Sunday's Showcase, Calls It 'A True Celebration' With 'A Swathe' Of Reveals
summary:
Marking 25 years of the brand.

Listen, it's no secret what we'll be getting with the Xbox Games Showcase 2026 this Sunday - lots and lots of reveals, both for first-party and third-party games, along with the special Gears of War: E-Day Direct at the end.

It's still always interesting to see how Xbox is teasing it though, and for this year's version in particular, they seem to be making a point of highlighting that it's a "true celebration" - a chance to mark the 25th anniversary of Xbox in style.
